panel.title: Spectrum
panel.saturatedBody: The source is too bright for SPHEREx: its centre was saturated in {{n}} of {{total}} exposures and none gave a valid measurement. No spectrum is shown, to avoid giving false numbers.
panel.saturatedBodyNoCount: The source is too bright for SPHEREx: its centre was saturated and no exposure gave a valid measurement. No spectrum is shown, to avoid giving false numbers.
panel.emptyTitle: No valid measurements at this point
panel.emptyBody: None of the {{n}} exposures gave a clean measurement: there were discarded pixels inside the aperture.
panel.footnote: Aperture photometry on each exposure: {{radius}} radius, background from an annulus, no aperture correction. Each exposure sees the object at a different wavelength and on a different date.

chart.label: Spectrum of {{name}}: flux in millijanskys against wavelength, from 0.75 to 5 micrometres. {{points}} points.
chart.hint: Move the pointer over the chart, or use the arrow keys, to read a value.
chart.legendBinned: Average per channel, with its error

fingerprint.title: Chemical fingerprint
fingerprint.intro: Compares the flux inside each band with the flux on both sides. It is a hint, not a detection: it does not replace a model fit.
fingerprint.excluded: Bands that fall in {{bands}} are not evaluated: the light measured there mostly belongs to another source.

listen.description: Sweeps the spectrum from left to right in {{seconds}} seconds: more flux sounds higher, and stretches without data are silent.

notice.saturated: Saturated source in {{bands}}: {{n}} of {{total}} exposures could not be measured.
notice.saturatedNoCount: Saturated source in {{bands}}: its centre has no valid measurement.
notice.offset: In {{bands}} the measured light is offset {{offset}} from the object: another source is inside the aperture and those points mostly belong to it.
notice.masked: {{n}} of {{total}} exposures were discarded because of bad pixels inside the aperture.
notice.waveTable: These exposures come from a different processing version than the wavelength table: wavelengths could be shifted.

request.loadingNote: That point is measured on every exposure of the field, one by one: it can take a few seconds.
request.errorTitle: The spectrum could not be obtained
